mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment (UNRATE above 4.0%) signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.0% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the trigger condition is not met.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (monetary tightening) and a decline in the INDPRO supply index create conflicting signals, amplifying market uncertainty and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises while INDPRO declines in the same month
regime_hint: monetary tightening coinciding with supply shock
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such instances are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction pattern does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by rising demand (GDPC1), S&P 500 forward returns are positively correlated over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained growth.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises by at least 5% in the next month
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not rise sufficiently or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant improvement in labor market conditions (UNRATE below 2.0%) signals stronger growth prospects, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 2.0% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the trigger condition is not met.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in employment (PAYEMS) alongside falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, boosting investor confidence and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises while UNRATE falls in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction pattern does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the INDPRO supply index reflects growing economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise sufficiently or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), investors anticipate higher interest rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns in such periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the trigger condition is not met.
